{{Top|leg}}
'''3-A''' was a level on the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] through which military security officers were to escort [[Kornell Divini]] to [[Hydroponics (Death Star)|Hydroponics]] eventually the detention block. However, before they could take a lift down, the corridor exploded as a result of the fighting during the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
